newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's BNI says assets growing.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's BNI says assets growing.

text.p: Total assets of Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI) grew by 8.9 percent to 37.99 trillion rupiah at the end of June this year from 34.88 trillion at end-December, BNI director Syarifuddin Hasan said on Thursday.

He said at a company briefing that the growth was due mainly to the expansion of net loans to 24.9 billion rupiah in June from 22.9 billion rupiah at the end of 1996, representing an increase of 8.7 percent.
BNI, the country's largest bank, earlier announced that its net profit in the first six months of the year rose 57.39 percent to 230.1 billion rupiah.
Syarifuddin said the return on the average total assets rose to 1.26 percent in the first half of this year compared with one percent in 1996.
He said non-interest income in 1996 accounted for 33.7 percent of total income, while in the first half of this year it was 26.54 percent and is expected to improve in the second semester.

Syarifuddin said non-performing loans increased slightly to 6.2 percent compared with 6.1 percent as of December last year. Non-performing loans stood at 1.42 trillion rupiah at December 1996 compared with 1.58 trillion at July this year.
